maisonNous.modesDesc: The 12 questions are the same in both cases. Together, you each answer separately and the quiz looks for the home that would suit your couple best.
maisonNous.modeDuoDesc: You each answer the 12 questions on the same phone, without seeing the other's answers.
maisonNous.modeDuoMeta: Your home as a couple and where you disagree
maisonNous.modeSolo: On my own, for our couple
maisonNous.modeSoloDesc: You answer with your couple in mind.
maisonNous.setupTitreDuo: What kind of house is right for you as a couple?
maisonNous.setupDescDuo: Enter your first names. The first person answers the 12 questions and then passes the phone. At the end, you'll see your home as a couple and the questions where you don't agree.
maisonNous.setupTitreSolo: What kind of house is right for you as a couple?
maisonNous.setupDescSolo: The quiz asks 12 questions about the life you want, for example about renovation work or the neighbours. Answer with your couple in mind and you'll see which home would suit you best.
maisonNous.relaisDebut: Answer the 12 questions, then pass the phone.
maisonNous.relaisSuite: {{nom}} is done. Your turn, no peeking at their answers!
maisonNous.chacunMeme: On your own, you would each have picked the same place. Now you just have to find it!
maisonNous.chacunGagne: Your home as a couple is {{nom}}'s pick. It's the one with the most points when your answers are added up.
maisonNous.chacunCompromis: Your home as a couple isn't the one either of you picked alone. It's the one with the most points when your answers are added up.
maisonNous.memesReponsesUne: Just one identical answer out of {{total}}.
maisonNous.accordHaut: You picture more or less the same place.
maisonNous.accordMoyen: You agree on the main things but there are two or three points left to talk about.
maisonNous.accordBas: You don't picture the same life at all. Talk it over before you view anything!
maisonNous.jaugesTitre: The places that would suit you best
maisonNous.invitationDuo: And what does your partner think? Take the quiz again together to see which questions you disagree on.
maisonNous.noteFin: This quiz is a game. It gives you an idea but it doesn't replace an estate agent's advice. The photos were created for this page.
maisonNous.p_pavillon_d: It's a house of your own on a quiet street, with a bit of garden and room to store things. It suits couples who want to settle down for a long time and have friends over on Saturdays. You'll also be able to grow the family without having to move.
maisonNous.p_pavillon_a: Take a good look at the commute. A house with a garden is often further from work and from nights out. Do the drive on a Monday morning before you commit.
maisonNous.p_appartement_d: In the city centre, you do everything on foot. The bakery and the cinema are a few minutes from your door. You'd rather have a balcony than a lawn to mow and you don't want to spend your weekends doing DIY. You'll have fewer square feet but there will be far more life around you.
maisonNous.p_appartement_a: The two things to check are noise and the lack of outdoor space. View the apartment in the evening and at the weekend, not just on a Tuesday at 3 p.m.
maisonNous.p_campagne_d: It's an old stone house with shutters and a vegetable patch. You want space and quiet, and you like pottering around outside on Sundays. Your friends will come for the weekend and they'll find it hard to leave!
maisonNous.p_campagne_a: In the countryside you often need a car each and the doctor isn't always round the corner. The best thing is to rent a house there for a winter before you buy.
maisonNous.p_loft_d: A loft is a former factory or workshop, with huge windows and one big living space. You love the city and evenings that end late at your place. Small closed-off rooms are not for you.
maisonNous.p_loft_a: Because there are no walls, there isn't much privacy either. If one of you goes to bed earlier than the other, plan at least one real bedroom. Also ask how much the heating costs.
maisonNous.p_architecte_d: It's a modern house with big picture windows, designed especially for you. You have precise tastes and you don't like building work that drags on. You're also ready to pay the price.
maisonNous.p_architecte_a: Agree on the budget before you meet the architect and not after. It's the kind of project where the bill climbs very fast.
maisonNous.p_tiny_d: A tiny house is a very small wooden house of about two hundred square feet, often set in the middle of nature. You own very little and you'd take freedom over floor space. Living on top of each other doesn't scare you.
maisonNous.p_tiny_a: Before you take the plunge, rent one for a week, in winter if you can. Also look into the land, because you can't park it just anywhere.
maisonNous.p_renover_d: It's an old house where everything needs redoing, and you can already see your future home in it. You like projects that last for years and dust doesn't scare you. You'd rather redo everything your way than buy a house that's already finished.
maisonNous.p_renover_a: Renovations often put couples to the test. Get a quote for the work before you buy and count on twice the time planned. Also keep one liveable room where you can catch your breath.
maisonNous.p_van_d: With a camper van, your home has four wheels and you get a new view every morning. All you need to be happy is a bed and a camping stove. The house with a twenty-five-year mortgage can wait.
maisonNous.p_van_a: Start by renting a van for a month before you sell everything. Also keep an address somewhere, if only to get your post.
maisonNous.p_peniche_d: On a houseboat, you live on the water and often very close to the city centre. You want an unusual place and a bit of rocking doesn't bother you. You'll have a deck for your plants and ducks for neighbours!
maisonNous.p_peniche_a: A houseboat needs a lot of upkeep and the mooring has to be paid for every month. Go and talk to people who live on a boat before you take the plunge.
maisonNous.p_palier_d: You're a couple but you each live in your own place, a few steps from each other. At least one of you needs their own space or their own hours. You don't see why you'd have to share a bathroom to love each other, and you meet up for dinner.
maisonNous.p_palier_a: It works really well for some couples, as long as it's a choice you've made together. If one of you dreams of living together, it's better to say so openly.
